abilities.description: You start with a Heart value of 3, no matter what, and may distribute 2, 2, 2, 1 however you like.

Ithorian bellow: You may @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ff32c523829d6481]{Endure Stress} (-2) in order to give vent to an air-rending bellow against an organic being. If you do this in close-quarters combat, you automatically are placed in control. And if you get a strong hit, mark progress. With a strong hit with a match, any being that is the target, and that is not an Extreme or Epic foe, is immediately stunned to unconsciousness. You may start the game with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.bcc219b0ebfb5c68]{Diplomat} asset, @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.d0f668219593b7a5]{Artist} asset, or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.87222132d6c0379b]{Courier} asset (you still get your usual starting assets).
